name: The Mustard Seed
overview: The parable of the mustard seed, as taught by Jesus in Matthew 13 and Mark 4, illustrates the kingdom of heaven beginning from the smallest and least significant seed to growing into a large tree that provides shelter, symbolizing the expansive and transformative power of God's kingdom. Jesus emphasizes that even faith as small as a mustard seed can move mountains, demonstrating that genuine faith, though seemingly small, holds divine power to accomplish the impossible. This teaching calls believers to trust in God’s sovereign work and the potency of faith rooted in Him, reflecting the Lord’s shepherding care as expressed in Psalms 23.
